name: @nubiia/mcp-newsapi

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search news articles (NewsAPI.ai / Event Registry). Cost: 1 token per call (measured live) when limited to the last 31 days (the default); querying the historical archive (allow_archive=true) costs extra tokens per year touched. At least one of keyword / concept_uris / category_uris / source_uris / location_uris is required. Prefer concept_uris (from suggest_concepts, which is free) over free-text keyword for any company, person, place or organisation: keyword is for free terms/topics and is noisy with common words (e.g. "Telefónica" also matches the Spanish adjective "telefónica"), so resolve entities with suggest_concepts first and pass concept_uris. Results are compact: title, truncated body (body_len, default 300 chars), url, source, date, sentiment. Defaults to 10 results, newest first, duplicates skipped. Paginate with `page`; check `total` and `pages` in the response.

keyword.description: Free-text keyword or phrase, for topics and general terms (e.g. "inflation", "wildfire"). Do NOT use it for companies, people, places or organisations: common words double as names (e.g. "Telefónica" also matches the ordinary Spanish adjective "telefónica") and produce irrelevant results. For those entities call suggest_concepts first and pass the returned URI in concept_uris.

concept_uris.description: Concept URIs for entities: companies, people, places, organisations. PREFERRED over keyword for any named entity: first call suggest_concepts (free) to resolve the name, then pass the returned `uri` here. Multiple values are OR-ed and far more precise than keyword, which avoids homonym noise. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

category_uris.description: Category URIs, e.g. "news/Business" (use suggest_categories). OR-ed. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

source_uris.description: News source URIs, e.g. "bbc.co.uk" (use suggest_sources). OR-ed. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

location_uris.description: Location URIs where the news happened (use suggest_locations). OR-ed. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

lang.description: 3-letter ISO 639-3 language codes, e.g. "spa" or ["eng", "spa"]. OR-ed. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

date_start.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Must be within the last 31 days unless allow_archive=true, which makes date_start mandatory.

date_end.description: Latest date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive); must be >= date_start. With allow_archive the date_start → date_end (default today) span may be at most 1 year.

allow_archive.description: Default false: search only the last 31 days (cheapest). Set true to reach the historical archive, which costs extra tokens per year queried; requires date_start and a range of at most 1 year.

keyword_loc.description: Where to look for the keyword (default: the API default, body).

keyword_search_mode.description: How to match the keyword: simple (any word), exact, or phrase.

ignore_source_uris.description: Exclude these news sources. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

data_types.description: Content types to include (default: all). Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

sort_by.description: Sort order (default date). "rel" ranks by relevance to the query.

count.description: Articles per page, 1-100 (default 10). Keep small to save context.

body_len.description: Max body characters per article, 0-5000 (default 300; 0 = no body).

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get one article by its URI (the `uri` returned by search_articles), with a longer body (body_len, default 3000 chars). Cost: 1 token per call. Use after search_articles when you need to read the article rather than just its headline.

article_uri.description: Article URI as returned by search_articles (e.g. "8512345678").

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search news EVENTS: clusters of articles about the same real-world happening, with a title, summary, date, location, key concepts and article count. Best for "what is happening with X" — one event replaces dozens of near-duplicate articles. Cost: 5 tokens (measured live) per call within the last 31 days (default); allow_archive=true costs extra per year touched. At least one of keyword / concept_uris / category_uris / source_uris / location_uris is required. Defaults to 10 events, newest first; use sort_by="size" for the biggest stories. Use get_event for details on one. For companies, people, places or organisations, resolve them with suggest_concepts first and pass concept_uris; keyword is for free terms/topics and is noisy with common words (e.g. "Telefónica" also matches the Spanish adjective "telefónica").

keyword.description: Free-text keyword or phrase, for topics and general terms (e.g. "inflation", "wildfire"). Do NOT use it for companies, people, places or organisations: common words double as names (e.g. "Telefónica" also matches the ordinary Spanish adjective "telefónica") and produce irrelevant results. For those entities call suggest_concepts first and pass the returned URI in concept_uris.

concept_uris.description: Concept URIs for entities: companies, people, places, organisations. PREFERRED over keyword for any named entity: first call suggest_concepts (free) to resolve the name, then pass the returned `uri` here. Multiple values are OR-ed and far more precise than keyword, which avoids homonym noise. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

category_uris.description: Category URIs, e.g. "news/Business" (use suggest_categories). OR-ed. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

source_uris.description: News source URIs, e.g. "bbc.co.uk" (use suggest_sources). OR-ed. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

location_uris.description: Location URIs where the news happened (use suggest_locations). OR-ed. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

lang.description: 3-letter ISO 639-3 language codes, e.g. "spa" or ["eng", "spa"]. OR-ed. Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

date_start.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Must be within the last 31 days unless allow_archive=true, which makes date_start mandatory.

date_end.description: Latest date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive); must be >= date_start. With allow_archive the date_start → date_end (default today) span may be at most 1 year.

allow_archive.description: Default false: search only the last 31 days (cheapest). Set true to reach the historical archive, which costs extra tokens per year queried; requires date_start and a range of at most 1 year.

min_articles_in_event.description: Only events covered by at least this many articles (filters noise).

sort_by.description: Sort order (default date). "size" = most articles first.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get one event by URI (the `uri` from search_events, e.g. "eng-1234567"). Returns its summary info by default; set include_articles=true to instead list the articles covering it (paginated, default 5 per page, body truncated to body_len). Cost: 5 tokens (info view) or 1 (articles view), measured live.

include_articles.description: Return the event’s articles instead of its info (default false).

tools.name: suggest_concepts
tools.description: Resolve a name to concept URIs (people, organisations, places, Wikipedia topics). Pass the returned `uri` as concept_uris to search_articles / search_events — much more precise than a keyword. Does not consume search tokens. Sorted by prominence in the news; check `type` and `label` to pick the right homonym.

prefix.description: Text typed so far (a name or the start of one), e.g. "Telef" or "bbc".

types.description: Restrict to these concept kinds (default: all). Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

lang.description: Language of the prefix, ISO 639-3 (default eng).

tools.name: suggest_categories
tools.description: Resolve a topic name to category URIs (e.g. "news/Business", "dmoz/Sports/Soccer"). Pass the `uri` as category_uris to search_articles / search_events. Does not consume search tokens.

prefix.description: Text typed so far (a name or the start of one), e.g. "Telef" or "bbc".

tools.name: suggest_sources
tools.description: Resolve a publication name or domain to news source URIs (e.g. "bbc.co.uk"). Pass the `uri` as source_uris to search_articles / search_events. Does not consume search tokens.

prefix.description: Text typed so far (a name or the start of one), e.g. "Telef" or "bbc".

data_types.description: Restrict to sources of these content types (default: all). Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

tools.name: suggest_locations
tools.description: Resolve a city or country name to a location URI. Pass the `uri` as location_uris to search_articles / search_events to find news that happened there. Does not consume search tokens.

prefix.description: Text typed so far (a name or the start of one), e.g. "Telef" or "bbc".

lang.description: Language of the prefix, ISO 639-3 (default eng).

tools.name: get_trending_concepts
tools.description: Get the concepts (people, organisations, places) that are trending right now in the news — computed by comparing mentions in the last 2 days against the last 2 weeks. Use `source` to switch between news, social, pr and blog (blog trends are not computed on every plan: the API then answers "not computed" and the call is still billed). Defaults to the top 10 people/organisations/places in news. Cost: 10 tokens per call regardless of count (measured live) - the priciest tool, use sparingly.

source.description: Data source to compute trends from (default news).

concept_types.description: Concept kinds to include (default: person, org, loc). Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get the token budget of this NewsAPI.ai account: tokens available, used and remaining for the current period. Call it before a batch of searches (measured costs: search_articles and get_article 1 token, search_events and get_event info 5, get_trending_concepts 10). Free: does not consume tokens itself. Suggest tools are free too. Also reports this server’s session budget (NEWSAPI_AI_MAX_TOKENS_PER_SESSION, default 200): calls that would exceed it fail locally without reaching the API.
